topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 29 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (storage, nodelegatecall, owned). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
